185	# rsync wrapper. ADDITIVE - never --delete: a mirror faithfully replicates the
186	# deletion you are trying to recover from. (The Windows original mirrored the
187	# cloud snapshots with /MIR; the macOS port makes every destination additive.)
188	function Invoke-Rsync($src, $dst, [string[]]$excludeDirs, [string[]]$excludeFiles, [string[]]$extraArgs = @()) {
189	    if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { return $null }
190	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
191	    # --modify-window=5: the CloudStorage mount rounds mtimes it did not itself write,
192	    # typically 1-2s below what rsync set. rsync's quick-check is size+mtime, so a
193	    # byte-identical file whose stored mtime drifted reads as changed and is re-sent
194	    # EVERY run, forever. Measured 2026-08-14 on codex/sessions: 256/256 files
195	    # size-identical, yet 134 re-sent nightly (252MB) purely on 1-2s skew. That
196	    # perpetual write load is what fed the FUSE wedge below. A 5s window absorbs the
197	    # rounding without hiding real edits (a real edit moves size or mtime far more).
198	    # Do NOT swap this for --size-only: claude-projects has genuine same-size edits
199	    # that only mtime catches.
200	    $a = @('-a', '--no-specials', '--no-devices', '--modify-window=5') + $extraArgs
201	    if ($DryRun) { $a += '-n' }
202	    foreach ($d in $excludeDirs)  { $a += "--exclude=$d/" }
203	    foreach ($f in $excludeFiles) { $a += "--exclude=$f" }
204	    $a += @("$src/", "$dst/")
205	    # Guard the launch, and clear $LASTEXITCODE first: if rsync never runs, a stale
206	    # exit code from an earlier command would make a zero-byte copy report OK.
207	    $rsync = '/usr/bin/rsync'
208	    if (-not (Test-Path $rsync)) {
209	        $Errors.Add('rsync-missing')
210	        Log "RSYNC binary not found at $rsync - copy SKIPPED (not a success)"
211	        return $false
212	    }
213	    # WATCHDOG. rsync against the CloudStorage mount can wedge indefinitely. Observed
214	    # 2026-08-14 on codex/sessions with an ALREADY-COMPLETE 256/256 mirror: the client and
215	    # its --server receiver both sat at ~0.02s CPU across 85 minutes and ignored SIGTERM.
216	    # Because the Drive snapshots run BEFORE the SSD capture, one wedged copy silently
217	    # costs the whole orphan/working-tree layer for that night - the run never gets there.
218	    # So: no single copy may block the run. Bound it and move on.
219	    # Two details that cost hours to learn, do not "simplify" them away:
220	    #   - SIGTERM does not clear a wedged rsync. Only SIGKILL does.
221	    #   - The --server child's argv[0] is bare "rsync", not the full path, so an anchored
222	    #     pattern like "^/usr/bin/rsync" matches the client ONLY and strands the receiver.
223	    #     Match on the destination path instead - it appears in both command lines.
224	    $tmpOut = [IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
225	    $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
226	    $job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock {
227	        param($exe, $argv, $out)
228	        & $exe @argv *> $out
229	        $LASTEXITCODE
230	    } -ArgumentList $rsync, $a, $tmpOut
231	
232	    if (Wait-Job $job -Timeout $RsyncTimeoutSec) {
233	        $code = [int](Receive-Job $job)
234	        Remove-Job $job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
235	    } else {
236	        Stop-Job $job -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
237	        Remove-Job $job -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
238	        & /usr/bin/pkill -9 -f -- "$dst" 2>$null
239	        $code = 124
240	        $Errors.Add('rsync-timeout')
241	        Log "RSYNC TIMEOUT after ${RsyncTimeoutSec}s, killed (-9): $src -> $dst"
242	    }
243	
244	    if (Test-Path $tmpOut) {
245	        Get-Content $tmpOut -Tail 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Add-Content -Path $LogFile
246	        Remove-Item $tmpOut -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
247	    }
248	    $global:LASTEXITCODE = $code
249	    return ($code -eq 0)
250	}

296	            Log "SNAP-GWS $src -> $archiveName : FAILED (tar archive not created)"
297	            return

300	        if ($rc -ne 0) {
301	            & /usr/bin/tar -tzf "$tmpDir/$archiveName" 2>$null | Out-Null
302	            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
303	                $Errors.Add("snapshot:$archiveName")
304	                Log "SNAP-GWS $src -> $archiveName : FAILED (tar exit $rc, archive unreadable)"
305	                return
306	            }
307	            Log "SNAP-GWS $src -> $archiveName : WARN tar exit $rc, archive lists OK"
308	        }
309	        Push-Location $tmpDir
310	        try {
311	            $q = "name = '$archiveName' and '$DriveMachineId' in parents and trashed = false"
312	            $params = @{ q = $q; fields = 'files(id,name)' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
313	            $listObj = Invoke-GwsJson @('drive', 'files', 'list', '--params', $params)
314	            $existingId = if ($listObj -and $listObj.files -and $listObj.files.Count -gt 0) { $listObj.files[0].id } else { $null }
315	            # One retry after a short pause, so one failed upload does not mark the snapshot as failed.
316	            $resObj = $null
317	            for ($try = 1; $try -le 2 -and -not ($resObj -and $resObj.id); $try++) {
318	                if ($try -gt 1) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; Log "SNAP-GWS $archiveName : retry after failed upload" }
319	                if ($existingId) {
320	                    $upParams = @{ fileId = $existingId; fields = 'id,name,size' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
321	                    $resObj = Invoke-GwsJson @('drive', 'files', 'update', '--params', $upParams, '--upload', "./$archiveName")
322	                } else {
323	                    $resObj = Invoke-GwsJson @('drive', '+upload', "./$archiveName", '--parent', $DriveMachineId)
324	                }
325	            }
326	            if ($resObj -and $resObj.id) {

328	                $Results.Add(@{ kind='snapshot'; name=$archiveName; status='OK' })
329	            } else {
330	                $Errors.Add("snapshot:$archiveName")
331	                Log "SNAP-GWS $src -> $archiveName : FAILED (gws upload failed)"
332	            }
333	        } finally {
334	            Pop-Location
335	        }
336	    } finally {
337	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmpDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
338	    }

390	# Capture what git will never carry. Authoritative source is git itself, not a
391	# path regex - an approximated .gitignore will drift from the real rules.
392	function Capture-RepoData($repoPath, $repoName, $ssdRoot) {
393	    $skipRe = '(^|/)(node_modules|\.venv|venv|__pycache__|\.next|\.build|dist|\.pytest_cache)(/|$)' + '|' + $CredDenyRe
394	    $copied = 0
395	    $denied = 0
396	
397	    $orphans = @()
398	    $orphans += (git -C $repoPath ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>$null)
399	    $orphans += (git -C $repoPath ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard 2>$null)
400	    foreach ($rel in ($orphans | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)) {
401	        if ($rel -match $skipRe) { if ($rel -match $CredDenyRe) { $denied++ }; continue }
402	        $s = Join-Path $repoPath $rel
403	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
404	        $d = Join-Path $ssdRoot "DEV-repo-data/$repoName/$rel"
405	        if (-not $DryRun) {
406	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $d -Parent) | Out-Null
407	            try { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $s -Destination $d -Force -EA Stop; $copied++ } catch {}
408	        } else { $copied++ }
409	    }
410	
411	    # Uncommitted edits to tracked files: GitHub holds only the last committed state.
412	    foreach ($rel in (git -C $repoPath diff --name-only 2>$null)) {
413	        $s = Join-Path $repoPath $rel
414	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s -PathType Leaf)) { continue }
415	        $d = Join-Path $ssdRoot "DEV-working-tree/$repoName/$rel"
416	        if (-not $DryRun) {
417	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $d -Parent) | Out-Null
418	            try { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $s -Destination $d -Force -EA Stop; $copied++ } catch {}
419	        } else { $copied++ }
420	    }
421	    if ($denied -gt 0) { $null = Log "  DENY $repoName : $denied credential file(s) excluded by policy" }
422	    return $copied
423	}

490	# --- 2a-db. Live DEV databases -> dev-databases.tgz (added 2026-10-20) ---
491	# cloud-push.py keeps DB files off the FUSE mount (sync can lock or corrupt a live DB).
492	# This stages a consistent copy of each live DB and uploads one archive through gws instead.
493	# Live = not under backups/, renv/, edge-profile/, .build/, printing-press-library/, and no
494	# 'before'/'backup' in the name. Dated backups stay local.
495	# shortcut: re-uploads the whole archive every night (~1 GB) and keeps only one cloud copy
496	# (update in place, no history); add a skip-if-unchanged hash check if upload time hurts.
497	function Snapshot-Databases {
498	    $stage = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "dev-db-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
499	    $root = Join-Path $stage 'dev-databases'
500	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null
501	    try {
502	        $prune = @('node_modules', '.venv', 'venv', '.git', 'renv', 'edge-profile', '.build', 'printing-press-library', 'backups')
503	        $findArgs = @("$U/DEV", '(')
504	        foreach ($p in $prune) { $findArgs += @('-name', $p, '-o') }
505	        $findArgs = $findArgs[0..($findArgs.Count - 2)] + @(')', '-prune', '-o', '-type', 'f',
506	            '(', '-name', '*.duckdb', '-o', '-name', '*.db', '-o', '-name', '*.sqlite', '-o', '-name', '*.sqlite3', ')',
507	            '!', '-iname', '*before*', '!', '-iname', '*backup*', '-print')
508	        $dbs = @(& /usr/bin/find @findArgs 2>$null)
509	        $ok = 0
510	        foreach ($src in $dbs) {
511	            $rel = $src.Substring("$U/DEV/".Length)
512	            $dst = Join-Path $root $rel
513	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $dst -Parent) | Out-Null
514	            $buf = New-Object byte[] 15
515	            $fs = [IO.File]::OpenRead($src)
516	            try { [void]$fs.Read($buf, 0, 15) } finally { $fs.Dispose() }
517	            $head = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($buf)
518	            if ($head -eq 'SQLite format 3') {
519	                # .backup gives a consistent copy even if a writer has it open.
520	                & /usr/bin/sqlite3 $src ".backup '$dst'" 2>$null
521	                $check = & /usr/bin/sqlite3 $dst 'PRAGMA quick_check;' 2>$null
522	                if ($check -ne 'ok') { $Errors.Add("db:$rel"); Log "DB $rel : FAILED (sqlite check: $check)"; continue }
523	            } else {
524	                # DuckDB: a plain copy is only safe when no process has the file open.
525	                $holders = & /usr/sbin/lsof -t -- $src 2>$null
526	                if ($holders) { $Errors.Add("db:$rel"); Log "DB $rel : SKIPPED (open by pid $($holders -join ','))"; continue }
527	                Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dst
528	                if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$src.wal") { Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$src.wal" -Destination "$dst.wal" }
529	            }
530	            $ok++
531	        }
532	        Log "DB staged $ok of $($dbs.Count) live databases"
533	        if ($ok -gt 0) { Snapshot-Gws $root 'dev-databases.tgz' @() }
534	    } finally {
535	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
536	    }
537	}

540	# --- 2a-zotero. Zotero library -> zotero.tgz (added 2026-10-23, Eric picked weekly + only-if-changed) ---
541	# ~/Zotero was in no backup layer. zotero.org sync is not a backup (deletions sync too).
542	# Uploads at most once per 7 days, and only when zotero.sqlite or storage/ changed since the last OK upload.
543	# The stamp file's mtime marks the last OK upload. Staging uses APFS clones (cp -c), so it costs no disk.
544	# shortcut: one cloud copy, updated in place (no history); keep dated copies if a bad sync ever needs undoing.
545	function Snapshot-Zotero {
546	    $zdir = "$U/Zotero"
547	    $stamp = "$LogDir/zotero-snapshot.stamp"
548	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$zdir/zotero.sqlite")) { Log "ZOTERO skip (no $zdir/zotero.sqlite)"; return }
549	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stamp) {
550	        $last = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $stamp).LastWriteTime
551	        if ((Get-Date) - $last -lt [TimeSpan]::FromDays(7)) { Log "ZOTERO skip (last upload $($last.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')), weekly)"; return }
552	        $newer = @(& /usr/bin/find "$zdir/zotero.sqlite" "$zdir/storage" "$zdir/styles" -newer $stamp -print -quit 2>$null)
553	        if ($newer.Count -eq 0) { Log "ZOTERO skip (unchanged since $($last.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')))"; return }
554	    }
555	    $started = Get-Date  # stamp with the start time, so edits made during the upload count as changes next time
556	    $stage = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "zotero-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
557	    $root = Join-Path $stage 'Zotero'
558	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null
559	    try {
560	        # .backup gives a consistent copy; Zotero holds an exclusive lock while open, so then it fails.
561	        & /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$zdir/zotero.sqlite" ".backup '$root/zotero.sqlite'" 2>$null
562	        $check = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$root/zotero.sqlite") { & /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$root/zotero.sqlite" 'PRAGMA quick_check;' 2>$null } else { 'no copy' }
563	        if ($check -ne 'ok') { Log "ZOTERO skip (database copy failed: $check; Zotero open?) - retries next run"; return }
564	        foreach ($d in @('storage', 'styles')) {
565	            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$zdir/$d") { & /bin/cp -cR "$zdir/$d" "$root/$d" }
566	        }
567	        $before = $Errors.Count
568	        Snapshot-Gws $root 'zotero.tgz' @()
569	        if (-not $DryRun -and $Errors.Count -eq $before) {
570	            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stamp)) { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $stamp | Out-Null }
571	            (Get-Item -LiteralPath $stamp).LastWriteTime = $started
572	        }
573	    } finally {
574	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
575	    }
576	}

685	$harvest = "$U/.claude/scripts/harvest-dev-docs.sh"
686	if ($IsMacOS -and (Test-Path $harvest) -and -not $DryRun) {
687	    $hvOut = (& /bin/bash $harvest 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
688	    Log "HARVEST $hvOut"
689	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $Errors.Add("harvest-dev-docs: $hvOut") }
690	}
691	
692	# --- 2c. Full memsearch reindex (no session-time cap) ---
693	$msExe = "$U/.local/bin/memsearch"
694	if (-not (Test-Path $msExe)) { $msExe = (Get-Command memsearch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
695	if ($msExe -and -not $DryRun) {
696	    $msFail = $false
697	    # Single source of truth: KeystoneOS data/memory-index-paths.json.
698	    $msPathsFallback = @(
699	        "$U/.claude/global-memory/transcripts",
700	        "$U/.claude/projects/C--Users-eric-rash/memory",
701	        "$U/.claude/claude-memory-compiler/daily",
702	        "$U/.claude/claude-memory-compiler/knowledge",
703	        "$U/SecondBrain/Knowledge",
704	        "$U/Desktop/SecondBrain/Knowledge"
705	    )
706	    $msConfig = "$DevRoot/KeystoneOS/data/memory-index-paths.json"
707	    $msPaths = $null
708	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $msConfig) {
709	        try {
710	            $declared = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $msConfig | ConvertFrom-Json).paths
711	            if ($declared -and $declared.Count -ge 1) {
712	                # {VAULT}: ~/SecondBrain on the Mac, ~/Desktop/SecondBrain on Windows (2026-09-30).
713	                $vaultRoot = @("$U/SecondBrain", "$U/Desktop/SecondBrain") | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
714	                if (-not $vaultRoot) { $vaultRoot = "$U/SecondBrain" }
715	                $msPaths = @($declared | ForEach-Object { (($_ -replace '\{HOME\}', $U) -replace '\{DEV\}', $DevRoot) -replace '\{VAULT\}', $vaultRoot })
716	                Log "INDEX path set: $($msPaths.Count) paths from memory-index-paths.json"
717	            }
718	        } catch { Log "INDEX config unreadable ($($_.Exception.Message)) - using built-in fallback list" }
719	    }
720	    if (-not $msPaths) {
721	        $msPaths = $msPathsFallback
722	        $Errors.Add('memsearch-index-config-missing')
723	        Log "INDEX path set: built-in fallback ($($msPaths.Count) paths) - memory-index-paths.json not usable"
724	    }
725	    # Shares the SessionEnd hook's lock. Reclaim only a dead owner.
726	    $indexLockFile = "$U/.claude/global-memory/transcripts/.memsearch-index.lock"
727	    $indexLockStaleMs = 5 * 60 * 1000
728	    $haveIndexLock = $false
729	    try {
730	        $lockStream = [System.IO.File]::Open($indexLockFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew)
731	        $lockStream.Close()
732	        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($indexLockFile, [string]$PID)
733	        $haveIndexLock = $true
734	    }
735	    catch {
736	        $ownerAlive = $false
737	        try {
738	            $ownerPid = [int](Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $indexLockFile)
739	            $null = Get-Process -Id $ownerPid -ErrorAction Stop
740	            $ownerAlive = $true
741	        } catch {}
742	        if (-not $ownerAlive) {
743	            $lockStale = $false
744	            try { $lockStale = (((Get-Date) - (Get-Item -LiteralPath $indexLockFile).LastWriteTime).TotalMilliseconds -ge $indexLockStaleMs) }
745	            catch { $lockStale = $true }
746	            if ($lockStale) {
747	                try {
748	                    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $indexLockFile -Force -ErrorAction Stop
749	                    $lockStream = [System.IO.File]::Open($indexLockFile, [System.IO.FileMode]::CreateNew)
750	                    $lockStream.Close()
751	                    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($indexLockFile, [string]$PID)
752	                    $haveIndexLock = $true
753	                } catch {}
754	            }
755	        }
756	    }
757	
758	    if (-not $haveIndexLock) {
759	        Log "INDEX skipped - another index run is active; next hook/nightly pass will catch up"
760	    }
761	    else {
762	        try {
763	            $existingPaths = @($msPaths | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ })
764	            if ($existingPaths.Count -gt 0) {
765	                $r = & $msExe index $existingPaths 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
766	                Log "INDEX full set: $r"
767	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $msFail = $true; $Errors.Add("memsearch-index:full-set") }
768	            }
769	        }
770	        finally {
771	            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $indexLockFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
772	        }
773	    }
774	    if (-not $msFail -and $haveIndexLock) {
775	        Remove-Item "$U/.claude/global-memory/transcripts/.memsearch-timeout-streak" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
776	        Log "INDEX complete - hook timeout-streak counter reset"
777	    }
778	} elseif (-not $msExe) { $Errors.Add('memsearch-exe-missing'); Log "INDEX skipped: memsearch not found" }

780	# --- 2c-recall. Does recall.py still open the right file? (added 2026-10-23) ---
781	# No model, ~1 s: the 30-case eval + the bench questions against baseline.json. Replaces the
782	# retired Windows weekly recall-eval chain. A drop becomes one backup error, so it reaches
783	# .errors.log and every session shows it at startup; nobody has to remember to run it.
784	$recallCheck = "$U/.claude/scripts/recall-bench/check.py"
785	$pyExe = @('/opt/homebrew/bin/python3', '/usr/bin/python3') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1

788	    Log "RECALL $rcOut"

790	}

792	# --- 2d. Mirror the recovery guide to the cloud backup root via gws ---
793	if ($GwsExe -and (Test-Path "$U/.claude/RESTORE.md") -and -not $DryRun) {
794	    Push-Location "$U/.claude"
795	    try {
796	        $upParams = @{ fileId = $DriveRestoreId; fields = 'id,name' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
797	        $resObj = Invoke-GwsJson @('drive', 'files', 'update', '--params', $upParams, '--upload', './RESTORE.md')
798	        if ($resObj -and $resObj.id) { Log "RESTORE.md mirrored to _MACHINE/Backups/ (via gws)" }
799	    } finally {
800	        Pop-Location
801	    }
802	}
803	
804	# --- 3. State + escalation ---
805	$status = if ($Errors.Count -eq 0) { 'OK' } else { 'ERROR' }
806	@{
807	    lastRun  = (Get-Date -Format 'o')
808	    status   = $status
809	    errors   = @($Errors)
810	    okCount  = $Results.Count
811	    dryRun   = [bool]$DryRun
812	} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $StateFile
813	
814	if ($Errors.Count -gt 0 -and -not $DryRun) {
815	    $line = "[{0}] daily-backup: {1} error(s): {2} - see ~/.claude/scripts/logs/daily-backup.log" -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), $Errors.Count, ($Errors -join ', ')
816	    Add-Content -Path $ErrorsLog -Value $line
817	}
818	
819	# Keep the log from growing unbounded.
820	if ((Get-Item $LogFile).Length -gt 2MB) {
821	    Get-Content $LogFile -Tail 2000 | Set-Content $LogFile
822	}
823	
824	Log "===== daily-backup end: $status ($($Errors.Count) errors) ====="
825	if ($Errors.Count -gt 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }

1	# STORAGE — where every file lives
2	
3	Read this before you save, move, back up, or copy any file. One rule set for every agent
4	(Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) on every machine. Decided by Eric 2026-10-16.
5	
6	## The model
7	
8	Every file has one **true copy**. Edit the true copy, or a working copy that syncs back to it
9	the same day. Everything else is a **backup** (machine-written, never edited) or **scratch**
10	(thrown away).
11	
12	Drive is the one place Eric looks. Documents live there directly. Code lives in GitHub and is
13	mirrored into Drive, so Drive still shows everything.
14	
15	## Where things go
16	
17	| What you are saving | True copy | Work on it at | Gets back to the true copy by |
18	|---|---|---|---|
19	| Document, PDF, deck, spreadsheet for humans | Drive `00_Primary_Storage_Drive/`, filed by its `README.md` ladder | Drive desktop app, or `~/DEV/_DRIVE` | Drive sync (automatic) |
20	| Finished deliverable from a repo | Drive `00_Primary_Storage_Drive/03_REPORTS/`, named `YYYY-MM-DD_<Sport>_<Topic>_<Audience>.<ext>` | made in `<repo>/outputs/` | `closeout` copies it (copy, keep the repo one) |
21	| Code, scripts, project docs, `STATUS.md` | GitHub `erash11/<repo>` | `~/DEV/<repo>` | `git commit` + `git push`, every session |
22	| Generated output (charts, exports, logs) | `<repo>/outputs/` | same | regenerate from code; gitignore it if large |
23	| Database (DuckDB, SQLite) | local disk, inside its repo or `~/DEV` | same | daily (daytime: hourly 12:00-17:00 via `scripts/daily-backup-login.sh`) `daily-backup.ps1` stages the live DBs (not dated `before`/`backup` copies) into `dev-databases.tgz`, uploaded via `gws` to Drive `_MACHINE/Backups/Machine` (since 2026-10-20; one copy, no history) |
24	| Secrets (`.env`, tokens, keys) | macOS Keychain or local `.env` | same | nowhere else — never in git, Drive, or chat |
25	| Claude/Codex config, skills, memory | GitHub `dotclaude`, `claude-skills`, `claude-global-memory` | `~/.claude` | `git push` (daily-backup also pushes) — the home of each agent file kind is in "Agent files" below |
26	| A loose file with no home yet | `~/DEV/_INBOX/` | same | `weekly-review` drains it within 7 days |
27	| Temporary agent work | the session scratchpad | same | thrown away |
28	
29	Identifiable athlete health data (`DexaProject`, case reviews like `SpecialRequests/TOS_ES`) stays
30	where it is: local or its one Drive folder. Never push it to GitHub, never paste it into chat or an
31	external service. A folder with a `CLAUDE.md` saying "local only" is in this class.
32	
33	## Agent files (decided 2026-10-24)
34	
35	One home per kind. Every other copy is a symlink to it, a generated view, or gone.
36	
37	- **Instructions, settings:** the `~/.claude` root, tracked by the dotclaude whitelist. The backup of a tracked config file is its git history: never leave a `.bak` copy beside it (dotclaude ignores `**/*.bak*`); commit before a risky edit. Untracked root files (`machine.md`, `~/.claude.json`) have no backup beyond the CRASHBOX SSD layer.
38	- **Hook scripts:** `~/.claude/hooks/`. A hook Codex also runs is a symlink in `~/.codex/hooks/`, never a copy. Never remove or reorder an entry in `~/.codex/hooks.json`: Codex keys its trusted hashes by entry position.
39	- **Installed tools:** `~/.claude/skill-router` is staged by `~/DEV/TypeSafe_Sandbox/skill_router/install.py`; edit the source and reinstall, never in place. `~/.claude/permission-gate` holds the shadow log written by `TypeSafe_Sandbox/permission_gate`.
40	- **Skills:** owned skills in `~/.claude/skills` (claude-skills). `~/.codex/skills` and the owned links in `~/.agents/skills` are generated by `~/.claude/skills/sync-to-codex.sh`. `~/.agents/skills` is the third-party pool: no bulk installs.
41	- **Plugins, caches, app state:** app-owned (`~/.claude/plugins`, `cache/`, `backups/`, `jobs/`, `context-mode/`, `~/.codex/packages`, `plugins`, `.tmp`, `~/Library/Application Support/Claude`). Tidy them only with the app's own commands (`claude plugin uninstall`, `ctx_purge`). Never move them by hand; never put your files inside.
42	- **Memory facts:** Tier B `~/.claude/global-memory/{USER,MEMORY}.md`; Tier A `~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/`, where the slug is the absolute cwd with every non-alphanumeric (`_` included) turned to `-`; repo facts in `<repo>/docs/`.
43	- **Handoffs:** `<repo>/docs/handoffs/`; workspace or system work with no single repo: `~/DEV/docs/handoffs/`. `~/.claude/global-memory/handoffs/` is read-only history.
44	- **Audits:** `~/.claude/audits/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md` (the script-bound `KeystoneOS/docs/audits/` and the vault's `SecondBrain/audits/` excepted). Audit clock: `~/DEV/KeystoneOS/docs/rot.md`, the one copy.
45	- **Logs and alerts:** job logs in `~/.claude/scripts/logs/`; a tool's own log in its own folder, never at the `~/.claude` root. Clear `.errors.log` only by appending it to `transcripts/.errors-ledger.log`.
46	- **Search roots:** `~/DEV/KeystoneOS/data/memory-index-paths.json` lists every record home above. `harvest-dev-docs.sh` mirrors repo docs into it and skips the health and local-only class above. Never run `memsearch index` by hand.
47	- **Retired:** projects to `~/DEV/_ARCHIVE/`, drained copies to `~/_PARKED_COPIES/`, proven clutter to `~/.Trash/<name>-<date>`.
48	
49	## Machine-written copies (backups)
50	
51	Scripts write to Drive `_MACHINE/`. Humans browse `00_Primary_Storage_Drive/`. Nothing lives in both.
52	
53	- `_MACHINE/Cloud_Copy/DEV` — one-way mirror of `~/DEV`, minus databases, secrets, and regenerable/catalog
54	  caches (`printing-press-library`, `graphify-out/cache`, `.build`, `node_modules`, `.venv`, `__pycache__`).
55	  Written by `~/.claude/scripts/cloud-push.py` (07:00 and 17:30).
56	- `_MACHINE/Backups/Machine` — daily (daytime: hourly 12:00-17:00 via `scripts/daily-backup-login.sh`) `.tgz` snapshots of `~/.claude/projects`, Codex, Gemini, and LaunchAgents
57	  uploaded directly by `gws` API (`daily-backup.ps1` `Snapshot-Gws`); `zotero.tgz` (`~/Zotero` database, PDFs,
58	  styles) at most weekly and only when Zotero changed (`Snapshot-Zotero`, since 2026-10-23); plus SSD captures of repo data git does not
59	  carry from `~/.claude/scripts/backup-manifest.json`.
60	- External SSD `CRASHBOX` — second daily copy when CRASHBOX is plugged in at midday.
61	
62	Read a backup to restore. Edit only the true copy. To add a path to the backups, add it to
63	`backup-manifest.json`; a path missing from the manifest is not backed up.
64	
65	## How agents reach Drive
66	
67	- Read, list, move, and upload through the API: the `gws` CLI (`gws drive files …`), or the Drive MCP.
68	  Moves keep file IDs; use `gws drive files update` with `addParents`/`removeParents`.
69	- The mount (`~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-…`) is for Eric and for `cloud-push.py`. Agent
70	  reads through it can hang, and its view can lag the server by days. Before trusting the mount,
71	  compare its folder list with `gws drive files list`.
72	- `gws --upload` only takes a path inside the current directory: `cd` to the file's folder first.
73	
74	## Places that are never a destination
75	
76	Baylor OneDrive, `~/Desktop`, `~/Downloads`, and the Drive root. If something lands in one of
77	these, file it by the table above in the same session.
78	
79	## Before you finish a session
80	
81	- Every repo you touched: committed and pushed.
82	- Every deliverable you made: copied to `03_REPORTS/`.
83	- Every new top-level folder in `~/DEV`: has a `portfolio.json` row (`new-project` does this).
84	
85	## Known gaps (2026-10-16)
86	
87	- The Mac's Drive mount went stale because DriveFS was choked on 68,000+ small files in
88	  `_MACHINE/Cloud_Copy/DEV` (`printing-press-library`, `graphify-out/cache`, leftover `node_modules`).
89	  Those folders were trashed on Drive via `gws` and excluded in `cloud-push.py` (cutting the file count
90	  from 104,945 to ~33,735), and `daily-backup.ps1` now uploads its Drive `.tgz` snapshots, receipt, and
91	  `RESTORE.md` directly via the `gws` API to `_MACHINE/Backups/Machine`, so a lagging local mount can
92	  never block nightly backups.
93	- Night backups failed whenever the Mac slept on battery (every 21:00 run 10-13 to 10-22). Since 2026-10-22 the
94	  backup runs in the daytime: launchd tries hourly 12:00-17:00 through `scripts/daily-backup-login.sh`, which runs
95	  it only on AC power, at most 2 tries a day, and stops once a run ends OK.
96	- `cloud-push.py` could not run straight from launchd (macOS blocks it from Terminal-made Drive files). Since
97	  2026-10-23 launchd opens it in Terminal via `scripts/cloud-push-launch.sh`; a run that never starts logs an ERROR.
98	- Windows laptop: retired as a work box 2026-10-14; desktop-app sessions only since 2026-10-21. It follows this same table:
99	  documents through Drive sync, code through `git pull`/`git push`, never a second true copy.
100	
101	Background and history: `~/DEV/docs/FILE-ORGANIZATION-PLAN.md`.

#!/bin/bash
# Gate for daily-backup.ps1. Both launchd jobs call it:
#   com.keystone.dailybackup        hourly 12:00-17:00, so a failed try gets another chance
#   com.keystone.dailybackup-login  at login, so a Mac that was off still gets a backup
# Runs the backup only when: no run ended OK today, the Mac is on AC power, no backup is
# running, and fewer than 2 real runs started today (a lasting error must not run 6 times).
# Why daytime + AC: every 21:00 run from 10-13 to 10-22 ended ERROR because the Mac slept
# on battery, and caffeinate -s only holds sleep off on AC (audit 2026-10-22).
# shortcut: checks the log, not a lock file; two runs at the same moment could both start.
LOG="${BACKUP_LOG:-$HOME/.claude/scripts/logs/daily-backup.log}"
TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
skip() { echo "$(date '+%F %T') gate skip: $1"; exit 0; }

grep -q "^$TODAY .*daily-backup end: OK" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null && skip "already OK today"
pmset -g ps | grep -q "AC Power" || skip "on battery"
# [.] keeps the pattern from matching any shell whose command line merely mentions the script
pgrep -f "pwsh.*daily-backup[.]ps1" >/dev/null && skip "a backup is already running"
STARTS=$(grep -c "^$TODAY .*daily-backup start (DryRun=False)" "$LOG" 2>/dev/null)
[ "${STARTS:-0}" -ge 2 ] && skip "2 tries already today"

exec /usr/bin/caffeinate -i -s /opt/homebrew/bin/pwsh -NoProfile -File "$HOME/.claude/scripts/daily-backup.ps1"

    $U = "$T/home"; $LogDir = "$U/.claude/scripts/logs"; $LogFile = "$LogDir/daily-backup.log"; $DevRoot = "$U/DEV"
    $DryRun = $false
    $Errors = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    $Results = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    $LogLines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    function Log($msg) { $LogLines.Add("$msg"); "  LOG $msg" | Out-Host }
    function Reset { $Errors.Clear(); $LogLines.Clear() }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $LogDir, "$U/.claude/global-memory/transcripts" | Out-Null

    $want = 'Invoke-GwsJson', 'Snapshot-Gws', 'Snapshot-CodexConfig', 'Get-IndexIncompleteRun', 'Invoke-UvPrune',
            'Invoke-LogTrim', 'Remove-OldFiles', 'Invoke-Rsync', 'Snapshot-Additive'
    $fns = @($ast.FindAll({ $args[0] -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.FunctionDefinitionAst] -and $want -contains $args[0].Name }, $true))
    $fns | ForEach-Object { . ([scriptblock]::Create($_.Extent.Text)) }
    Check "loaded $($fns.Count) of $($want.Count) functions" ($fns.Count -eq $want.Count)
    foreach ($s in $ast.EndBlock.Statements) {
        if ($s.Extent.Text -match '^\$(CredDenyDirs|CredDenyFiles|CredDenyRe|RsyncTimeoutSec)\s*=') { . ([scriptblock]::Create($s.Extent.Text)) }
    }

    # ---- fakes ----
    Set-Content -LiteralPath "$T/bin/gws" -Value @'
#!/bin/bash
# Fake gws: copy any uploaded archive to $FAKE_OUT, answer like the API.
for a in "$@"; do case "$a" in ./*.tgz) cp "$a" "$FAKE_OUT/";; esac; done
case "$*" in *"files list"*) echo '{"files":[]}';; *) echo '{"id":"fake-id","name":"x"}';; esac
'@
    Set-Content -LiteralPath "$T/bin/memsearch" -Value @'
#!/bin/bash
echo "$@" > "$FAKE_DIR/ms-called"
case "$FAKE_MS_MODE" in
  zero) echo "Indexed 0 chunks.";;
  some) echo "scanning"; echo "Indexed 5 chunks.";;
  garbage) echo "Traceback (most recent call last):";;
  fail) echo "Error: milvus down" >&2; exit 1;;
esac
'@
    Set-Content -LiteralPath "$T/bin/uv" -Value @'
#!/bin/bash
echo "${UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT:-unset}" > "$FAKE_DIR/uv-timeout"
echo "$*" >> "$FAKE_DIR/uv-calls"
case "$*" in
  *"cache size"*) echo "warning: experimental" >&2; if [ -f "$FAKE_DIR/pruned" ]; then echo "0.5GiB"; else echo "1.0GiB"; fi;;
  *"cache prune"*)
    case "$FAKE_UV_MODE" in
      ok) echo "Pruning cache at: /x" >&2; echo "Removed 12 files (500MiB)" >&2; touch "$FAKE_DIR/pruned";;
      lock) echo 'error: Timeout (10s) when waiting for lock on `/x/.lock` at `/x`, is another uv process running? You can set `UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT` to increase the timeout.' >&2; exit 2;;
      *) echo "error: Permission denied (os error 13)" >&2; exit 2;;
    esac;;
esac
'@
    & /bin/chmod +x "$T/bin/gws" "$T/bin/memsearch" "$T/bin/uv"
    $GwsExe = "$T/bin/gws"; $DriveMachineId = 'fake-parent'

    # ---- R23: codex-config.tgz ----
    "--- R23 codex-config snapshot"
    $cx = "$U/.codex"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$cx/rules", "$cx/packages/p", "$cx/plugins/q", "$cx/.tmp/r", "$cx/cache/s",
        "$cx/computer-use/t", "$cx/visualizations/v", "$cx/sessions/2026/cache", "$cx/work/w" | Out-Null
    'model = "x"' | Set-Content "$cx/config.toml"
    '{"hooks":[]}' | Set-Content "$cx/hooks.json"
    'prefix_rule()' | Set-Content "$cx/rules/default.rules"
    '{"t":1}' | Set-Content "$cx/history.jsonl"
    '{"secret":"never"}' | Set-Content "$cx/auth.json"
    foreach ($d in 'packages/p', 'plugins/q', '.tmp/r', 'cache/s', 'computer-use/t', 'visualizations/v', 'work/w') { 'x' | Set-Content "$cx/$d/f.txt" }
    'keep' | Set-Content "$cx/sessions/2026/cache/keep.txt"
    & /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$cx/memories_1.sqlite" 'PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; create table m(x); insert into m values(1);' | Out-Null
    & /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$cx/state_5.sqlite" "create table t(x); insert into t values('kept');" | Out-Null
    # session_index.jsonl left out on purpose: a missing item is a logged skip, not an error.
    Reset
    Snapshot-CodexConfig
    $list = @(& /usr/bin/tar -tzf "$T/out/codex-config.tgz" 2>$null)
    Check 'codex-config.tgz uploaded through gws' ($list.Count -gt 0)
    foreach ($n in 'config.toml', 'hooks.json', 'rules/default.rules', 'memories_1.sqlite', 'state_5.sqlite', 'history.jsonl') {
        Check "archive holds $n" ($list -contains "codex-config/$n")
    }
    Check 'archive never holds auth.json' (-not ($list -match 'auth\.json'))
    Check 'archive holds only the allowlist (no packages, sessions, work)' (-not ($list -match '/(packages|sessions|work|plugins)/'))
    Check 'missing session_index.jsonl logged as skip' (@($LogLines -match 'CODEX skip \(missing\).*session_index\.jsonl').Count -eq 1)
    Check 'no errors' ($Errors.Count -eq 0)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$T/x" | Out-Null
    & /usr/bin/tar -xzf "$T/out/codex-config.tgz" -C "$T/x"
    Check 'state_5.sqlite copy passes quick_check' ((& /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$T/x/codex-config/state_5.sqlite" 'PRAGMA quick_check;') -eq 'ok')
    Check 'state_5.sqlite copy holds the row' ((& /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$T/x/codex-config/state_5.sqlite" 'select x from t;') -eq 'kept')
    Check 'old codex-memories/codex-agents snapshot lines are gone' (-not ($ScriptText -match "Snapshot-Gws .*'codex-(memories|agents)\.tgz'"))

    "--- R23 .codex SSD excludes (real rsync, fixture paths)"
    $m = [regex]::Match($ScriptText, "if \(\`$entry\.path -eq '\.codex'\) \{ \`$extra = (@\([^)]*\)) \}")
    Check 'found the .codex exclude line' $m.Success
    $extra = & ([scriptblock]::Create($m.Groups[1].Value))
    Reset
    $ok = Snapshot-Additive $cx "$T/ssd/codex" $extra
    Check 'Snapshot-Additive ok' ($ok -eq $true)
    foreach ($d in 'packages', 'plugins', '.tmp', 'cache', 'computer-use', 'visualizations', 'work') { Check "SSD copy skips top-level $d" (-not (Test-Path "$T/ssd/codex/$d")) }
    Check 'SSD copy keeps a nested cache folder (anchored exclude)' (Test-Path "$T/ssd/codex/sessions/2026/cache/keep.txt")
    Check 'SSD copy keeps config.toml' (Test-Path "$T/ssd/codex/config.toml")
    "  INFO auth.json reaches the SSD copy: $(Test-Path "$T/ssd/codex/auth.json") (not on the credential deny-list; pre-existing)"

    # ---- HARNESS #4: previous-run check ----
    "--- HARNESS #4 previous-run check"
    $died = @('2026-10-20 00:00:01 ===== daily-backup start (DryRun=False) run=20261020-000001 =====',
              '2026-10-20 00:05:30 RECEIPT drive : verified run=20261020-000001 (via gws)',
              '2026-10-20 00:05:30 INDEX path set: 13 paths from memory-index-paths.json')
    $okRun = @('2026-10-21 08:00:00 ===== daily-backup start (DryRun=False) run=20261021-080000 =====',
               '2026-10-21 08:14:06 INDEX path set: 13 paths from memory-index-paths.json',
               '2026-10-21 09:26:33 INDEX full set: Indexed 150 chunks.',
               '2026-10-21 09:26:34 ===== daily-backup end: OK (0 errors) =====')
    $skipRun = @('2026-10-22 08:00:00 ===== daily-backup start (DryRun=False) run=20261022-080000 =====',
                 '2026-10-22 08:10:00 INDEX path set: 13 paths from memory-index-paths.json',
                 '2026-10-22 08:10:00 INDEX skipped - another index run is active; next hook/nightly pass will catch up')
    $dry = @('2026-10-23 08:00:00 ===== daily-backup start (DryRun=True) run=20261023-080000 =====',
             '2026-10-23 08:01:00 ===== daily-backup end: OK (0 errors) =====')
    Check 'died block -> its run id' ((Get-IndexIncompleteRun $died) -eq '20261020-000001')
    Check 'complete block -> nothing' ($null -eq (Get-IndexIncompleteRun ($died + $okRun)))
    Check 'INDEX skipped block -> nothing' ($null -eq (Get-IndexIncompleteRun $skipRun))
    Check 'died block then a dry run -> still found' ((Get-IndexIncompleteRun ($died + $dry)) -eq '20261020-000001')
    Check 'empty log -> nothing' ($null -eq (Get-IndexIncompleteRun @()))
    $real = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath "$HOME/.claude/scripts/logs/daily-backup.log" -Tail 3000)
    "  INFO real log's last real run -> '$(Get-IndexIncompleteRun $real)' (the run going on now shows here; the live-pwsh guard stops a false error)"
    $pat = [regex]::Match($ScriptText, "pgrep -f '([^']+)'").Groups[1].Value
    $hits = @(& /usr/bin/pgrep -f $pat 2>$null)
    $names = @($hits | ForEach-Object { (& /bin/ps -o comm= -p $_ 2>$null) })
    "  INFO guard pattern '$pat' matches pids: $($hits -join ',') ($($names -join ','))"
    Check 'guard pattern never matches caffeinate' (-not ($names -match 'caffeinate'))

    # ---- HARNESS #3 + #4 in-run: the real index statement, fake memsearch ----
    "--- HARNESS #3 index logging (real statement, fake memsearch)"
    $idx = $ast.EndBlock.Statements | Where-Object { $_.Extent.Text -like 'if ($msExe -and -not $DryRun)*' } | Select-Object -First 1
    Check 'found the index statement' ($null -ne $idx)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$U/notes/sub", "$U/empty", "$DevRoot/KeystoneOS/data" | Out-Null
    'a' | Set-Content "$U/notes/a.md"; 'b' | Set-Content "$U/notes/b.md"; 'c' | Set-Content "$U/notes/sub/c.md"; 'x' | Set-Content "$U/empty/x.txt"
    $cfg = "$DevRoot/KeystoneOS/data/memory-index-paths.json"
    '{"paths":["{HOME}/notes","{HOME}/notes/sub","{HOME}/missing"]}' | Set-Content $cfg
    $lock = "$U/.claude/global-memory/transcripts/.memsearch-index.lock"
    function RunIndex($mode, $exe = "$T/bin/memsearch") {
        Reset; Remove-Item "$T/bin/ms-called" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        $env:FAKE_MS_MODE = $mode; $script:msExe = $exe
        . ([scriptblock]::Create($idx.Extent.Text))
    }
    RunIndex 'zero'
    Check 'zero: logs counts, overlap counted once, quiet-day note' (@($LogLines -match '^INDEX full set: Indexed 0 chunks\. \(2/3 paths exist, 3 \.md files scanned; no new content since last index, exit 0\)$').Count -eq 1)
    Check 'zero: no errors' ($Errors.Count -eq 0)
    Check 'zero: lock released' (-not (Test-Path $lock))
    RunIndex 'some'
    Check 'some: no note, no errors' ((@($LogLines -match '^INDEX full set: Indexed 5 chunks\. \(2/3 paths exist, 3 \.md files scanned, exit 0\)$').Count -eq 1) -and $Errors.Count -eq 0)
    RunIndex 'garbage'
    Check 'garbage output -> memsearch-index:unexpected-output' (@($Errors) -contains 'memsearch-index:unexpected-output')
    RunIndex 'fail'
    Check 'exit 1 -> memsearch-index:full-set' (@($Errors) -contains 'memsearch-index:full-set')
    '{"paths":["{HOME}/empty","{HOME}/missing"]}' | Set-Content $cfg
    RunIndex 'zero'
    Check 'no .md input -> memsearch-index:no-input, memsearch not called' ((@($Errors) -contains 'memsearch-index:no-input') -and -not (Test-Path "$T/bin/ms-called"))
    Check 'no input -> NOT RUN line' (@($LogLines -match '^INDEX full set: NOT RUN - nothing to index \(1/2 paths exist, 0 \.md files scanned\)$').Count -eq 1)
    '{"paths":["{HOME}/notes"]}' | Set-Content $cfg
    RunIndex 'zero' "$T/bin/no-such-memsearch"
    Check 'index step throws -> memsearch-index:no-result (in-run #4)' ((@($Errors) -contains 'memsearch-index:no-result') -and (@($LogLines -match 'NO RESULT').Count -eq 1))
    Check 'index step throws -> lock still released' (-not (Test-Path $lock))

    "--- uv cache prune (fake uv)"
    $stamp = "$LogDir/uv-prune.stamp"
    $env:FAKE_UV_MODE = 'lock'; Reset
    Invoke-UvPrune "$T/bin/uv" $stamp
    Check 'lock: "uv-prune: skipped (locked)", no error, no stamp' ((@($LogLines) -contains 'uv-prune: skipped (locked)') -and $Errors.Count -eq 0 -and -not (Test-Path $stamp))
    Check 'UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=10 reached uv' ((Get-Content "$T/bin/uv-timeout") -eq '10')

    Invoke-UvPrune "$T/bin/uv" $stamp
    Check 'other failure -> uv-prune error, no stamp' ((@($Errors) -contains 'uv-prune') -and -not (Test-Path $stamp))
    $env:FAKE_UV_MODE = 'ok'; Reset
    Invoke-UvPrune "$T/bin/uv" $stamp
    Check 'ok: "uv-prune: ok 1.0GiB->0.5GiB" and stamp written' ((@($LogLines) -contains 'uv-prune: ok 1.0GiB->0.5GiB') -and (Test-Path $stamp) -and $Errors.Count -eq 0)

    Invoke-UvPrune "$T/bin/uv" $stamp
    Check 'second call the same day does nothing' ((@(Get-Content "$T/bin/uv-calls").Count -eq $calls) -and $LogLines.Count -eq 0)
    (Get-Item $stamp).LastWriteTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-1); Remove-Item "$T/bin/pruned"; Reset
    Invoke-UvPrune "$T/bin/uv" $stamp
    Check 'stamp from yesterday -> runs again' (@($LogLines -match '^uv-prune: ok ').Count -eq 1)
    Remove-Item $stamp; $DryRun = $true; $calls = @(Get-Content "$T/bin/uv-calls").Count; Reset
    Invoke-UvPrune "$T/bin/uv" $stamp
    Check 'dry run: logs only, uv not called' ((@($LogLines -match 'dry-run').Count -eq 1) -and (@(Get-Content "$T/bin/uv-calls").Count -eq $calls))
    $DryRun = $false
    Check 'call site uses ~/.local/bin/uv and a stamp in $LogDir' ($ScriptText -match 'Invoke-UvPrune "\$U/\.local/bin/uv" "\$LogDir/uv-prune\.stamp"')

    # ---- R22 log trims ----
    "--- R22 log trims"
    $big = "$T/logs/big.log"; $jl = "$T/logs/shadow.jsonl"; $small = "$T/logs/small.log"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$T/logs" | Out-Null
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $big -Value (1..30000 | ForEach-Object { "2026-10-24 00:00:00 line $_ padding padding padding padding padding" })
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $jl -Value (1..30000 | ForEach-Object { '{"n":' + $_ + ',"tool":"Bash","shape":"git status \"x\" é"}' })
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $small -Value (1..100 | ForEach-Object { "s $_" })
    $inode = (& /usr/bin/stat -f %i $big); $smallBefore = Get-FileHash $small
    "  INFO big.log $((Get-Item $big).Length) bytes, shadow.jsonl $((Get-Item $jl).Length) bytes"
    $DryRun = $true; Reset
    Invoke-LogTrim @($big)
    Check 'dry run: big.log untouched, logged' ((@(Get-Content $big).Count -eq 30000) -and (@($LogLines -match 'TRIM \[dry-run\]').Count -eq 1))
    $DryRun = $false; Reset
    Invoke-LogTrim @($big, $jl, $small, "$T/logs/missing.log")
    $b = @(Get-Content $big)
    Check 'big.log kept its last 2000 lines' ($b.Count -eq 2000 -and $b[0] -match 'line 28001 ' -and $b[-1] -match 'line 30000 ')
    Check 'big.log same inode (live O_APPEND writers keep writing to it)' ((& /usr/bin/stat -f %i $big) -eq $inode)
    $j = @(Get-Content $jl)
    Check 'jsonl: 2000 lines, each still valid JSON, unicode intact' ($j.Count -eq 2000 -and (($j | ForEach-Object { try { $null = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; 1 } catch { 0 } } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum -eq 2000) -and $j[-1] -match 'é')
    Check 'small.log (under 2 MB) unchanged' ((Get-FileHash $small).Hash -eq $smallBefore.Hash)
    Check 'two TRIM lines, no failures' ((@($LogLines -match '^TRIM .* : kept the last 2000 lines$').Count -eq 2) -and -not ($LogLines -match 'FAILED'))
    $tl = $ast.EndBlock.Statements | Where-Object { $_.Extent.Text -like '$TrimLogs = @(*' } | Select-Object -First 1
    . ([scriptblock]::Create($tl.Extent.Text))
    Check "call-site list: 10 paths, all built from `$U/`$LogDir/`$DevRoot" ($TrimLogs.Count -eq 10 -and -not ($TrimLogs | Where-Object { -not $_.StartsWith($U) }))
    foreach ($n in 'daily-backup.log', 'daily-backup.out', 'permission-gate/shadow.jsonl', 'Library/Logs/everythingd.log', 'scripts/flush.log',
                   'scripts/compile.log', 'scripts/adjudicate.log', 'outputs/morning/cadence.log', 'skill-router/skill_router.log', '.claude/skill_router.log') {
        Check "call-site list has $n" (@($TrimLogs | Where-Object { $_.EndsWith($n) }).Count -ge 1)
    }

    # ---- R22 60-day prune ----
    "--- R22 60-day prune"
    $inv = "$DevRoot/KeystoneOS/outputs/inventory"; $jobs = "$DevRoot/KeystoneOS/outputs/jobs"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$inv/sub", $jobs | Out-Null
    'o' | Set-Content "$inv/old.json"; 'n' | Set-Content "$inv/new.json"; 'o' | Set-Content "$inv/sub/old-nested.json"; 'o' | Set-Content "$jobs/old.log"
    foreach ($f in "$inv/old.json", "$inv/sub/old-nested.json", "$jobs/old.log") { (Get-Item $f).LastWriteTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-70) }
    (Get-Item "$inv/new.json").LastWriteTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-59)
    $DryRun = $true; Reset
    Remove-OldFiles @($inv, $jobs) 60
    Check 'dry run: nothing deleted, 2 lines logged' ((Test-Path "$inv/old.json") -and (Test-Path "$jobs/old.log") -and @($LogLines -match 'PRUNE \[dry-run\]').Count -eq 2)
    $DryRun = $false; Reset
    $ro = $ast.EndBlock.Statements | Where-Object { $_.Extent.Text -like 'Remove-OldFiles @(*' } | Select-Object -First 1
    . ([scriptblock]::Create($ro.Extent.Text))
    Check 'call site: old top-level files deleted in both folders' (-not (Test-Path "$inv/old.json") -and -not (Test-Path "$jobs/old.log"))
    Check '59-day file kept' (Test-Path "$inv/new.json")
    Check 'files in subfolders kept (top level only)' (Test-Path "$inv/sub/old-nested.json")
    Check 'one PRUNE line per folder' (@($LogLines -match '^PRUNE .* : deleted 1 file\(s\) older than 60 days$').Count -eq 2)
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $T -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item Env:FAKE_DIR, Env:FAKE_OUT, Env:FAKE_MS_MODE, Env:FAKE_UV_MODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
""
if ($script:fails -eq 0) { "ALL PASS" } else { "$($script:fails) FAILED" }
exit $script:fails

input.area: AREA B: daily backup script (~/.claude/scripts/daily-backup.ps1, backup-manifest.json, test files; HARNESS_FIXES #3, #4, #7)

changes.what: R22 + HARNESS #7. The old single-log trim is replaced by section 4 'Log housekeeping', which has two parts. (a) Invoke-LogTrim: same rule as before (over 2 MB keeps the last 2000 lines), now applied to 10 paths: daily-backup.log, daily-backup.out, permission-gate/shadow.jsonl, ~/Library/Logs/everythingd.log, memory-compiler flush/compile/adjudicate.log, KeystoneOS outputs/morning/cadence.log, skill-router/skill_router.log and ~/.claude/skill_router.log. Missing files are skipped. All paths are built from $U/$LogDir/$DevRoot. It reads the tail into a variable, then rewrites the file. The old code piped Get-Content into Set-Content on the same file, which can truncate it before the read ends; that code never fired because the log stayed under 2 MB. The rewrite keeps the same inode, and lsof +fg confirmed that everythingd and the job's stdout append with O_APPEND, so live writers are safe. It honors -DryRun, and a failed trim is logged but not counted as an error. (b) Remove-OldFiles: deletes top-level files in KeystoneOS outputs/inventory and outputs/jobs older than 60 days, in place, never ~/.Trash. It only deletes files with YYYY-MM-DD in the name (every file there today is dated; no symlinks, hidden or undated files), logs one PRUNE line per folder and honors -DryRun. On the first real run it will trim shadow.jsonl (5.9 MB, 19,697 lines) and everythingd.log (5.6 MB) and delete about 92 inventory files and 90 jobs files. Both backup logs are under 2 MB today, so #7 is fixed by mechanism and no trim has fired on them yet.

HARNESS #3: the 2026-10-03 patch is ported into the current index step. 'INDEX full set' now logs '<n>/<m> paths exist, <k> .md files scanned' and the exit code, and adds '; no new content since last index' on 0. The .md count is deduped by FullName because the Inbox and Inbox/meetings roots overlap; that is about 4,300 files today, all local with no symlinks. With no input it records memsearch-index:no-input and logs 'NOT RUN - nothing to index' without running memsearch. Output not matching '^Indexed N chunks' records memsearch-index:unexpected-output.

HARNESS #4, in two halves. (1) Next run: new Get-IndexIncompleteRun runs before the start line. It reads the last DryRun=False block of daily-backup.log (tail 3000). If that block has 'INDEX path set' but no 'INDEX full set' or 'INDEX skipped', it records index-incomplete:<runId> and logs why. It only checks the immediately previous real run, so an old death is not raised forever. It is skipped while another backup pwsh is alive; the pgrep pattern '^[^ ]*pwsh .*daily-backup[.]ps1' excludes $PID and does not match caffeinate. The 2026-10-20 00:05 run had this same failure. (2) In-run: a catch on the index try logs 'INDEX full set: NO RESULT - <msg>' and records memsearch-index:no-result when the step throws. Testing showed that a throw escapes try/finally without this catch.

R23. Removed the Snapshot-Gws lines for ~/.codex/memories (never existed) and ~/.codex/agents (empty). Added Snapshot-CodexConfig, which stages an explicit allowlist (config.toml, hooks.json, rules, memories_1.sqlite, state_5.sqlite, history.jsonl, session_index.jsonl) and uploads codex-config.tgz via gws. SQLite files are copied with sqlite3 .backup and checked with quick_check. Missing items are logged and skipped. auth.json is never staged; config.toml was checked and holds no credential keys. The .codex SSD capture excludes now read @('work','/packages','/plugins','/.tmp','/cache','/computer-use','/visualizations'). The leading '/' anchors each to the top of ~/.codex, so nested folders with the same name are still copied. The manifest has no excludes field, so the list stays on the script's existing hardcoded $extra line.

uv cache: new step 2e Invoke-UvPrune, placed before the State section so a real failure is counted. It runs '/usr/bin/env UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=10 ~/.local/bin/uv cache prune' (never --force). Sizes come from 'uv --preview-features cache-size cache size --human', and '?' is shown if that fails. Outcomes: 'uv-prune: ok <before>-><after>' plus the stamp ~/.claude/scripts/logs/uv-prune.stamp; 'uv-prune: skipped (locked)' when the output matches 'Timeout (Ns) when waiting for lock', which is not an error and writes no stamp; any other failure records a uv-prune error. 'At most once a day' is implemented as stamp-on-success: a lock skip leaves no stamp, so a second gated try that day tries again. It is skipped in -DryRun. The header Jobs list gained item 4 (housekeeping).

Added a 'note' to the .codex entry saying where its SSD excludes live (the script, since the manifest has no excludes field) and which gws archives serve its 'drive' destination (codex-sessions, codex-sqlite, codex-config; never auth.json). No other change by me. Note that the working tree also carries an earlier uncommitted change that is not mine: the DEV/claude-global-memory entry was removed at 00:18 by the 'dotclaude tidy' session. That folder is now a symlink to ~/.claude/global-memory, and DEFAULT-DENY skips symlinks, so the removal is consistent.

New offline test, built the same way as the 2026-10-23 fake-gws harness (jobs/802ea68a/tmp/bk/harness.ps1). It AST-loads functions and statements from daily-backup.ps1 and runs them against a temp fixture home with fake gws, uv and memsearch. No network, no real paths, no real index. It covers: parse, the codex-config.tgz contents (no auth.json, sqlite copy intact), real rsync with the anchored .codex excludes, Get-IndexIncompleteRun on 5 fixture logs plus the guard pattern, the real index statement in 6 modes, uv-prune in 6 cases, log trims (inode kept, JSONL stays valid, dry run) plus the call-site list, and the 60-day prune (dated-only, top level only, dry run). Run: pwsh -NoProfile -File ~/.claude/scripts/test_daily_backup.ps1

Moved #3, #4 and #7 to Done with the date 2026-10-24 and what was done; Open is now '(none)'. Adjusted the 10-03 note's 'items #3 and #4 above' wording. Each entry says it was offline-tested and that no real run has been seen yet.

changes.what: R22 + HARNESS #7. The old single-log trim is replaced by section 4 'Log housekeeping', which has two parts. (a) Invoke-LogTrim: same rule as before (over 2 MB keeps the last 2000 lines), now applied to 10 paths: daily-backup.log, daily-backup.out, permission-gate/shadow.jsonl, ~/Library/Logs/everythingd.log, memory-compiler flush/compile/adjudicate.log, KeystoneOS outputs/morning/cadence.log, skill-router/skill_router.log and ~/.claude/skill_router.log. Missing files are skipped. All paths are built from $U/$LogDir/$DevRoot. It reads the tail into a variable, then rewrites the file. The old code piped Get-Content into Set-Content on the same file, which can truncate it before the read ends; that code never fired because the log stayed under 2 MB. The rewrite keeps the same inode, and lsof +fg confirmed that everythingd and the job's stdout append with O_APPEND, so live writers are safe. It honors -DryRun, and a failed trim is logged but not counted as an error. (b) Remove-OldFiles: deletes top-level files in KeystoneOS outputs/inventory and outputs/jobs older than 60 days, in place, never ~/.Trash. It only deletes files with YYYY-MM-DD in the name (every file there today is dated; no symlinks, hidden or undated files), logs one PRUNE line per folder and honors -DryRun. On the first real run it will trim shadow.jsonl (5.9 MB, 19,697 lines) and everythingd.log (5.6 MB) and delete about 92 inventory files and 90 jobs files. Both backup logs are under 2 MB today, so #7 is fixed by mechanism and no trim has fired on them yet.

HARNESS #3: the 2026-10-03 patch is ported into the current index step. 'INDEX full set' now logs '<n>/<m> paths exist, <k> .md files scanned' and the exit code, and adds '; no new content since last index' on 0. The .md count is deduped by FullName because the Inbox and Inbox/meetings roots overlap; that is about 4,300 files today, all local with no symlinks. With no input it records memsearch-index:no-input and logs 'NOT RUN - nothing to index' without running memsearch. Output not matching '^Indexed N chunks' records memsearch-index:unexpected-output.

HARNESS #4, in two halves. (1) Next run: new Get-IndexIncompleteRun runs before the start line. It reads the last DryRun=False block of daily-backup.log (tail 3000). If that block has 'INDEX path set' but no 'INDEX full set' or 'INDEX skipped', it records index-incomplete:<runId> and logs why. It only checks the immediately previous real run, so an old death is not raised forever. It is skipped while another backup pwsh is alive; the pgrep pattern '^[^ ]*pwsh .*daily-backup[.]ps1' excludes $PID and does not match caffeinate. The 2026-10-20 00:05 run had this same failure. (2) In-run: a catch on the index try logs 'INDEX full set: NO RESULT - <msg>' and records memsearch-index:no-result when the step throws. Testing showed that a throw escapes try/finally without this catch.

R23. Removed the Snapshot-Gws lines for ~/.codex/memories (never existed) and ~/.codex/agents (empty). Added Snapshot-CodexConfig, which stages an explicit allowlist (config.toml, hooks.json, rules, memories_1.sqlite, state_5.sqlite, history.jsonl, session_index.jsonl) and uploads codex-config.tgz via gws. SQLite files are copied with sqlite3 .backup and checked with quick_check. Missing items are logged and skipped. auth.json is never staged; config.toml was checked and holds no credential keys. The .codex SSD capture excludes now read @('work','/packages','/plugins','/.tmp','/cache','/computer-use','/visualizations'). The leading '/' anchors each to the top of ~/.codex, so nested folders with the same name are still copied. The manifest has no excludes field, so the list stays on the script's existing hardcoded $extra line.

uv cache: new step 2e Invoke-UvPrune, placed before the State section so a real failure is counted. It runs '/usr/bin/env UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=10 ~/.local/bin/uv cache prune' (never --force). Sizes come from 'uv --preview-features cache-size cache size --human', and '?' is shown if that fails. Outcomes: 'uv-prune: ok <before>-><after>' plus the stamp ~/.claude/scripts/logs/uv-prune.stamp; 'uv-prune: skipped (locked)' when the output matches 'Timeout (Ns) when waiting for lock', which is not an error and writes no stamp; any other failure records a uv-prune error. 'At most once a day' is implemented as stamp-on-success: a lock skip leaves no stamp, so a second gated try that day tries again. It is skipped in -DryRun.
